analysis: Price has traded above the Value Area High at 74,616, but the breakout is heavily leverage-driven with perp CVD (+511.2) vastly outstripping spot CVD (+9.6). This extreme negative CVD divergence signals high exhaustion risk and vulnerable market structure if spot bids fail to absorb selling back into value.
key_risk: Perpetual long liquidation cascade triggered by a lack of spot market follow-through, risking a rapid pull-back inside the value area.
